changelog: **Stage SLA editor: cohort and mentor overrides (#1640):** `GET/PUT /api/admin/stage-sla` take an optional `cohortId`/`mentorId`; both are verified server-side against the admin's org (cohort of the org, MENTOR of the org) and an id that is not the org's answers 404. An override scope carries the service level only — escalation and WIP limits stay org-wide. The GET returns per stage the scope's own `days`, the `effective` value and what it would `inherit` (`inheritedSla()` in `src/lib/stageSlaRule.ts`), plus the org's cohorts and mentors for the selector. `StageSlaEditor` gains the cohort/mentor selector and shows "this cohort: 5 days · inherited from organisation: 7 days" (EN/TR/DE, MARKETING overlay says rep). e2e: `e2e/stage-sla-overrides.spec.ts`.

en: Stage service levels can now differ per cohort and per mentor: pick a cohort or mentor in the settings card to override the organisation's number and see which value applies.
tr: Aşama süre hedefleri artık dönem ve mentör bazında farklılaşabiliyor: ayarlar kartında bir dönem ya da mentör seçerek kurumun sayısını geçersiz kıl ve hangi değerin geçerli olduğunu gör.
de: Phasen-Servicelevels können jetzt je Kohorte und je Mentor:in abweichen: Wählen Sie in der Einstellungskarte eine Kohorte oder Mentor:in, um die Zahl der Organisation zu überschreiben, und sehen Sie, welcher Wert gilt.
